articles.title: BIS chief warns AI capex arms race relies on opaque debt, posing systemic risks
articles.snippet: Pablo Hernandez cited historical railway and dot-com bubbles to caution that spending driven by hype over actual profits risks broad economic corrections.

articles.title: Treasury yields continue to rise even as Bessent doubles down on bond buybacks
articles.snippet: Long-term yields moved higher despite a $6 billion Treasury buyback, as debt concerns and rising oil prices continue to pressure global bond markets.

articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev fires back at AMC's Aron in escalating fight over stock tokens
articles.snippet: Tenev told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Wednesday that public companies shouldn't have veto power over third-party securities that reference their shares.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
articles.snippet: Chinese-language platform Xinbi is accused of operating on crypto transactions as it offered services to other criminal networks.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
articles.snippet: Secretary Scott Bessent warned that failing to pass the CLARITY Act would send a “troubling signal” about America’s leadership in the digital asset industry.
